title: About 40 files still pass the old priority prop to next/image although the repo's own note says Next 16 replaced it with preload.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: PLAUSIBLE. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: components/marketing/site-image.tsx:26 ('Next 16 replaced priority with preload'); package.json next 16.4.3; priority still used in components/layout/marketing-header.tsx:144, components/frequency/site/shell/site-header.tsx:401, create-space-studio.tsx:568, frequency-join.tsx:467, niche-door.tsx:168, frequency-midnight.tsx:59 and ~35 more. node_modules absent so I could not read the Next docs to confirm it is a no-op or a warning.

WHY IT MATTERS: If deprecated it logs warnings and may be removed; if it already has no effect, those LCP images lose their preload and LCP slips on the join, create-a-space and theme pages.

FIX DIRECTION: Swap priority for preload across components; confirm against node_modules/next/dist/docs image page.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
